svg.aria-label: Commonwealth AI — an assistant that runs on your own computer
svg.title: Commonwealth AI — an assistant that runs on your own computer
svg.text: an assistant that runs on your own computer —
and across a few you trust, when one machine isn’t enough.
a few machines you trust, joined by invitation
answering as one — nothing leaves the group
no account · no subscription · no company in the middle — just the code, on your hardware
